premiumFeatures.rowCommentsContent: Collaborate directly in your table. Add comments to individual rows, mention team members, and keep the conversation in context.
premiumFeatures.kanbanViewContent: Organize your data visually on a Kanban board. Cards are grouped into stacks based on a single select field, and you can easily drag and drop them between stacks.
premiumFeatures.calendarViewContent: Easily see your rows on a calendar, using a date field of your choice. Perfect for keeping track of deadlines, events, and schedules at a glance.
premiumFeatures.timelineViewContent: Display rows along a horizontal timeline using start and end dates. Ideal for project planning and roadmaps.
premiumFeatures.exportsContent: Easily export your data in additional formats like Excel, JSON, and XML, or bulk-download all files from a table - perfect for backups, reports, and sharing with others.
premiumFeatures.rowColoringContent: Highlight rows with colors based on a single select field or custom conditions. This makes it easier to spot patterns and priorities.
premiumFeatures.rowNotificationsContent: Stay in the loop with customizable row comment notifications. Choose between receiving alerts for all comments or only when you're mentioned.
premiumFeatures.surveyFormContent: Collect responses one question at a time with survey mode. A simplified version of the form view, optimized for focus and ease of use.
premiumFeatures.publicLogoRemovalContent: Remove the 本系统 logo from public views to give your shared content a cleaner, more branded look.
premiumFeatures.personalViewsContent: Create views that only the author can see. This gives you space to experiment, filter, and sort data without affecting the workspace for others.
premiumFeatures.aiFeaturesContent: Use AI to automate and enhance your workflows. With the AI prompt field type you can generate text, summaries, or insights directly in cells based on a dynamic prompts that can reference other fields. Separately, you can also ask AI to create formulas for you.
premiumFeatures.chartWidgetContent: Visualize your data with charts on dashboards. Use any table as a data source, add multiple series, and group or sort by fields with rich summary options.
premiumFeatures.groupedAggregateRowsDataSourceContent: Group rows from a 本系统 table and calculate summaries for use in application builder pages.
